Getting Started
Quickstart
Copy page

Get CodeRabbit up and running in 2 minutes. Connect your repositories and start receiving AI-powered code reviews on your next pull request.

Want a guided tour? Explore key features with our hands-on guide using a provided demo project.
1

Sign up with your Git platform

Use your existing GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or Bitbucket account to create your CodeRabbit account. No credit card required!
2

Add your repositories

Add repositories that CodeRabbit should review. You control exactly which repos have access. For detailed instructions, choose your Git platform below.
GitHub.com
Public or private GitHub repositories
GitHub Enterprise Server
GitHub integration for enterprise teams
GitLab.com
Integrate with cloud GitLab.com
Self-managed GitLab
Connect your self-hosted GitLab instance
Azure DevOps
Seamless integration with Microsoft Azure DevOps
Bitbucket Cloud
AI code reviews for your Bitbucket Cloud repositories
3

Create a pull request

CodeRabbit automatically reviews every new pull request, providing actionable feedback within minutes.
​
Want a guided walkthrough?
New to CodeRabbit? Follow our Hands-on Guide to explore key features step-by-step using a test repository. You’ll learn how to:
See CodeRabbit perform an automated code review
Chat with CodeRabbit about its feedback
Generate code improvements automatically
Start the Hands-on Guide
A step-by-step walkthrough of CodeRabbit’s core features
